project.name: Ordie
project.boundarySource: OpenStreetMap hamlet node with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, neighbouring settlements and private properties do not inflate the settlement score.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A small hamlet with local landscape character but limited independent visitor depth.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Local outdoor access may support a dog walk, with close control around roads, livestock and wildlife.

townGuide.headline: A recorded locality pending any full destination audit
townGuide.intro: Resolved to Ordie near Dinnet and Milton of Logie, not the separate Ordie locality near Finzean. Nearby houses and attractions remain separately assessed.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector with its assessed score, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.

townStudyArea.sourceName: OpenStreetMap hamlet node with a conservative editorial study buffer
townStudyArea.notes: Ordie has no separate NRS locality polygon in the reference dataset. The published editorial boundary is therefore the strict heritage study area; the 500 m ring is context only.
